title: Latent-Predisposition Personas for Heterogeneous and Reliable LLM Survey Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM personas are used to simulate survey publics, which should reproduce not only answer distributions but also within-person coherence and stability. Drawing on mass belief systems research, we show that persona-conditioned LLMs produce over-constrained publics. Across three model families and three U.S. surveys, opinions on unrelated issues are 1.6-4.6 times as correlated as among humans, and party identification explains 2.5-7.6 times as much answer variance. Common remedies (temperature, diversity instructions, backstories) weaken these correlations by making answers more random. On Qwen, their ten-day test-retest reliability falls to 33-59% of the human level, and when made consistent they lose correlation fit. We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), whose persons differ stably, not randomly. Each persona receives political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations that grow as engagement falls. Answ

translated_title: 用于异质且可靠的LLM调查模拟的潜在倾向人格
translated_abstract: LLM人格被用于模拟调查公众，理想的模拟不仅应重现答案分布，还应重现个体内部的一致性与稳定性。借鉴大众信念系统研究，我们表明基于人格条件化的LLM会产生过度约束的公众。在三个模型家族和三项美国调查中，不相关问题之间的观点相关性达到人类水平的1.6-4.6倍，政党认同所解释的答案方差也达到人类水平的2.5-7.6倍。常见的补救方法（如温度调节、多样性指令、背景故事）通过使答案更加随机来削弱这些相关性。在Qwen模型上，这些方法十天的重测信度降至人类水平的33-59%，而若使其保持一致，它们又会失去相关性拟合。我们提出潜在倾向人格（LPP），其个体之间以稳定而非随机的方式存在差异。每个人格被赋予政治参与度、价值优先级以及随参与度下降而增大的政党相对议题偏差。
tldr: 提出潜在倾向人格（LPP）方法，通过为每个人格赋予稳定的政治参与度、价值优先级和政党相对议题偏差，使LLM模拟的调查公众具备人类般的异质性、个体内一致性与重测可靠性。
en_tdlr: We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), which assign each persona stable political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations, enabling LLM-simulated survey publics to achieve human-like heterogeneity, within-person coherence, and test-retest reliability.
